name: 46176 · Shelbyville, IN
findings: ZIP 46176 (Shelbyville) has 122 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46176 (Shelbyville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46176 (Shelbyville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
